duplicate_occurrences.method: 31 lifecycle records, 31 unique trade_id values -- verified by direct set-cardinality comparison

lookahead.method: Reused the canonical replay engine's own decision-cycle architecture unmodified (H1 bias resolved as of each session's ref_end, M15 decisions made only from candles up to the decision point, M1 fills only from candles after entry) -- this pilot introduced no new data-access path that could look ahead; verified structurally by reusing session_sweep_continuation.replay.run_replay and h1_bias.resolve_h1_market_bias unchanged rather than reimplementing lookahead-sensitive logic

timestamps_outside_development_interval.method: All 31 occurrences' entry_time fall within 2026-05-18T14:30:00Z .. 2026-06-15T14:30:00Z, strictly inside the frozen DEVELOPMENT common interval 2026-05-18..2026-06-19 (verified by direct min/max scan of wp2_run1_lifecycle_population.json)

oos_timestamps.method: DEVELOPMENT dataset files (2025-2026 EURUSD) and OOS dataset files (SSC1D_WP1_OOS_EURUSD_2024Q1, 2024 Q1) are non-overlapping calendar ranges; this run's driver script never opens or references the OOS raw files at all (grep-verifiable: no reference to data/research/ssc1d_pilot/ anywhere in scripts/run_ssc1d_wp2_baseline_replay.py)

final_holdout_timestamps.method: No final holdout dataset is defined anywhere in canonical SSC state (CURRENT_VALIDATION_STATE.json holdout: null); this run's driver script has no path to any holdout file

prospective_data_timestamps.method: DEVELOPMENT dataset's M1 leg physically ends 2026-07-31 (raw), well before the 2026-09-14 prospective boundary, and this run's own effective interval (2026-05-18..2026-06-19) ends even earlier; no post-2026-09-14 file is referenced anywhere in the driver script

m1_fills_correspond_to_eligible_m15_deci.method: M1 candles are passed into session_sweep_continuation.replay.run_replay as an additive parameter used only for entry-timing refinement within a setup that M15 decision logic already qualified -- this pilot did not alter that call contract or the underlying fill-resolution code path in any way

occurrence_identity_determinism.method: trade_id = f'{pair_id}_{d}_{entry_dict[entry_time]}_{model}' -- fully derived from deterministic replay inputs, not from wall-clock run time or any random/incidental state

cross_check_against_preexisting_gen001_p.significance: This pilot's fresh, independently-executed replay (new process, new timestamp, new git-commit-pinned run) reproduces byte-for-byte the same 31-occurrence population that GEN_001 produced under a separate script invocation on a separate occasion -- the strongest available reproducibility evidence, obtained without needing to touch or modify GEN_001's own existing artifacts

exclusions_recorded_not_dropped.note: These are decision-cycle-level exclusions (a session/date pair that did not produce an accepted entry for a stated reason), not dropped trades -- every one is counted and labeled, none silently discarded. The 31 resolved occurrences are a subset of 66 decision cycles after these documented exclusions; no occurrence with a non-null gross_R was excluded from the metric population.
